anchors.citation: ATO, "About the Corporate tax transparency report 2022-23" — 3,985 entities, $3,138.4b total income, $380.1b taxable income, $97.9b tax payable.
ATO, "About the Corporate tax transparency report 2023-24" — 4,110 entities, $3,278.8b total income, $365.5b taxable income, $95.7b tax payable.

gates.title: All eleven income years are present and populated
The Combined-sheet guard is load-bearing
gates.detail: reading every 2013-14 sheet yields 3741 rows; reading only Combined yields 1859. The guard suppresses a duplicate read of the first year.

gates.title: No entity holds two rows for one income year
Blank-ABN rows stay separate entities
gates.detail: 276 source rows have no ABN and resolve to 135 distinct entities (at least 26 required; keying on ABN alone would collapse them into one).

gates.title: Prior-year amendments are routed to their own income year
gates.detail: 668 rows carry an income year earlier than the workbook that ships them

gates.title: No row post-dates the workbook that published it
Every money value is finite and non-negative
The 2022-23 reporting-threshold cut shows as a population break
gates.detail: entities reported: 2021-22 2776 → 2022-23 4085 (+47.2%). Counts must never be trended across this boundary unqualified.

gates.title: The $200m+ cohort is continuous across the threshold change
2022-23 exceeds its as-published figures by a bounded amount (amendments)
gates.detail: panel holds 4085 entities / $3165.2b income / $98.3b tax; the ATO published 3985 / $3138.4b / $97.9b at the time. Growth of +100 entities is late lodgers and amendments arriving in later reports — it must be positive and small.

gates.title: 2023-24 exceeds its as-published figures by a bounded amount (amendments)
gates.detail: panel holds 4205 entities / $3304.6b income / $96.0b tax; the ATO published 4110 / $3278.8b / $95.7b at the time. Growth of +95 entities is late lodgers and amendments arriving in later reports — it must be positive and small.

gates.title: 2022-23: the known taxable-income divergence is within its expected band
gates.detail: summing the published column gives $405.1b against the ATO's stated $380.1b — 6.6% higher. Expected: consistently 3-12% higher. This is a documented property of the source, not a parse error; total income and tax payable reconcile exactly in the same year.

gates.title: 2023-24: the known taxable-income divergence is within its expected band
gates.detail: summing the published column gives $395.4b against the ATO's stated $365.5b — 8.2% higher. Expected: consistently 3-12% higher. This is a documented property of the source, not a parse error; total income and tax payable reconcile exactly in the same year.

gates.title: The sector classifier covers most of the tax base by value
gates.detail: 39.1% of entities and 83.9% of tax payable are classified (the remainder is shown as Unclassified, never hidden).
